buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration.

For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) 1. The Bidder should submit a copy of their PAN Card, GST registration certificate, proof of last month’s GS TR submission and certificate of incorporation/certificate of the firm/Company/Agency. 2. The bidder must be a primary manufacturer of LMO through air liquefaction process. 3. Accredited bidders should have their office registered within the state of Assam for last 5 years as docu mentary evidence. 4. The bidder should provide a company profile and brief indicating experience in manufacturing/supplying such items. 5. The bidder should have a minimum 5 years of experience in the supply of bid items to the various hospit als and research laboratories of the Government Organization without interruption of supply. 6. Detailed customer list with addresses, Phone number, Email id and name of contact person to be submit ted with satisfactory certificate from clients. 7. The bidder should have a similar kind of experience in supply of LMO to reputed Government of Assam, NE states and should provide purchase orders of those as documentary evidence. 8. The bidder must provide a certificate of satisfactory performance from the Government organization for recently completed similar contracts within last 5 years. 9. The service provider/bidder primary manufacturer of LMO through air liquefaction process, provided all the required document are submitted adequately. 10. And the rules and regulations laid down by concerned regulatory authority is complied. 11. The Bidder must have two or more Liquid Medical Oxygen (LMO) manufacturing plant of minimum Inst alled capacity of 50 MT per day. The plant must be in operation for minimum five year. 12. The bidder must have experience of supplying to minimum 6 (Six) Govt. hospitals of minimum 500 or more bedded. They should have experience in supply of minimum 50% of the annual tendered quantity to any one of the 6 hospitals in any of the last 3 financial years. Supporting Copies of supply order/contract/a pproved price list with satisfactory completion/performance documents in support of this must be provide d certificate/any other. 13. The bidder shall provide valid drug License for supply of LMO Medical gas oxygen issued by GoA/GoI. 14. The bidder must possess and dedicated minimum 5 No. of L.M.O. tankers for this purpose with valid PE SO License and stand by facility of at least 3 Nos. of L.M.O tankers (may be from outsourced with valid doc uments). The bidder should have the advance monitoring system for location tracking, speed tracking & vi sual monitoring of vehicle. The service provider shall enclose a certificate indicating total numbers of L.M. O. transport tanks in possession and permission to operate. 15. Delivery Period: During emergency and pandemic situation, the bidder must have the capacity to refill l iquid oxygen within a period of 4 hours to XXXX Medical College and Hospitals. During routine period the b idder must supply within 12 hours at XXXX MCH. 16. The approved rated will be valid for Two years in effect from the tender coming into force/date of agre ement, for the supply of indented quantities by XXXX Medical College & Hospital. 17. The Quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, loading and unloading charg es up to XXXX Medical College and Hospital, including maintenance of cryogenic storage tank, valve, mete r and LMO accessories for continuous hospital services. 18. During emergencies, such as pandemics, it is mandatory for all technically qualified bidders to promptl y supply Liquid Medical Oxygen (LMO) to XXXX Medical College Hospital, Assam. This must be done at the approved L1 rates. Failure to comply with this requirement will result in the bidder being blacklisted and b arred from taking part in future bids.

19. Price break up for L.M.O. to be submitted showing separately for Exfactory L.M.O. price including GST a nd Transportation, Labour expenses, Maintenance etc. indicating GST. A sample format of price breakup is furnished below. Conversion of NPPA unit to tender unit (i.e. Kg/ Cylinder) to be attached separately. 20. The bidder must submit: Non-conviction and Market Standing Certificate from Drug Control Department , Assam. GMP Certificate from Drugs Controller of the regulatory Authority of Manufacturing State/Country Annual Turnover in respect of Production Capacity from the Regulatory Authority of Manufacturing State/C ountry. 21. The bidder has not been blacklisted by any Government Organization during the last Five (05) years, n otarized affidavit must be submitted. Any bidder who was successfully qualified, however was unable to de liver as per requirement in their previous records, will not be considered for evaluation. The bidder must s ubmit successful completion certificate from order issuing authority for minimum 5 years. 22. The bidder must have possession of QC laboratory & must submit a certificate/letter from a competent person of Government in this regard. QC Certificate must be submitted in every lot of supply. The service provider must have their own full-fledged labs, with full time chemists to test each batch and to provide b est testing reports of previous year on demand. 23. The service providers must have in house facilities for testing/trace impurities in PPM/PPB range for CO , NO, Phosphine, Polymers, SO2 and argon, etc. the facilities should be open to scrutiny by the buyer. 24. The bidder must have valid GMP & BIS certificate/License. The tender committee (committee to be noti fied) may inspect the manufacturing plants of the bidder before awarding the contract if necessary. 25. Payment Terms: I. No Advance payments will be made to suppliers. II. Payment shall be made in India n Rupees in the following manner: On Final Acceptance: 100% of the contract price shall be paid to the Su pplier on submission of a claim supported by the acceptance certificate and relevant documents. However, payment will be subject to the availability of Fund, no interest is to be paid on late payment (if any). Oxyge n is an essential and lifesaving component for the hospital, in no case should the supply chain be broken, a nd uninterrupted supply is to be ensured by the successful bidder. 26. Acceptance & Rejection: The acceptance of the quotation will rest the XXXX Medical College & Hospital , Assam, who does not bind himself to accept the lowest quotation and reserves the right to himself to reje ct or accept, partially or all the quotations received, without assigning any reason. The Principal cum Chief Superintendent, XXXX Medical College and Hospital further reserves the right to withdraw the tender or pa rt thereof or modify the requirements without assigning any reason and right to relax any of the conditions in the best interest of the Institution. 27. The buyer shall obtain all the necessary licenses from time to time. All applicable licenses and certifica tes shall be valid at the time of award of contract and throughout the contract duration. 28. Buyers to ensure that all Provisions of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 as amended till date and rules m ade there under are duly complied with. 29. Liquid Medical Oxygen supplied by the Service Provider must strictly be made as per Static and Mobile Pressure Vessels Rule 2016 regulatory requirements as amended from time to time. 30. The supply of liqui d medical oxygen shall conform to specified codes (latest edition): Medical Oxygen I P (Indian Pharmacopo eia) 2018 and subsequent revision. 31. The service provider shall comply with all Provisions of Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 as amended till date and rules made there under and the same shall always be applicable. 32. All applicable licenses and certificates obtained by the Service Provider shall be valid at the time of aw ard of contract and throughout the contract duration. 33. The service provider has to provide the testing certificate for medical use of LMO as per IP 2018. 34. The Service Provider should be a manufacturer of Medical Gases i.e. LMO IP 2018 or any latest amend ed regulation with purity of LMO of 99% or more. 35. The quantity of gases can be increase or decrease by the Buyer as per GeM GTC. 36. The service provider should have separate tanks and filling decks for medical and industrial oxygen to avoid any chance of mix up which may be harmful to the patients. 37. All disputes are settled in the court of XXXX District Jurisdiction only.
38. All the Terms and Conditions mentioned in the GeM Service Level Agreement for Supply of Liquid Medi cal Oxygen will be by default incorporated in this document
